description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller class ContentBoxesController that manages administrative operations for content boxes in an e-commerce platform. The class includes request handlers for listing, creating, viewing details, and saving content boxes, along with utility methods for setting the UI menu and providing position options.

classes.name: ContentBoxesController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing content boxes in the admin interface, providing endpoints for listing, creating, viewing, and saving content box entities.

methods.name: listContentBoxes
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all content boxes, setting up the menu and returning the content pages view.

methods.name: createBox
methods.description: Handles GET requests for creating a new content box, initializing content with store info, setting default descriptions and positions, and returning the content details view.

methods.name: getContentDetails
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve and show details of a specific content box by ID, validating ownership and content type, and preparing descriptions and positions for display.

methods.name: saveContent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a content box, validating input, associating descriptions with the correct languages, setting content type and store, saving the content, and returning the details view with success message.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set the active menu items in the model for UI navigation.
